generations.memory_31: Signup simplification (SMB): signup +15%, activation +9%, qualified revenue +4%, but 30-day retention dipped -1%. Confirmed effect for SMB segment only — we haven't seen this replicate elsewhere, so don't roll out broadly assuming it'll hold for enterprise or other segments. Net positive on revenue despite the small retention hit, but worth keeping an eye on that retention trend if we lean further into this.
generations.memory_44: Enterprise sales-assisted CTA: signup dropped -12% (expected, it's a higher-friction path) but qualified leads +24% and qualified revenue +18%, retention flat. Confirmed win, but strictly an enterprise play — lower top-of-funnel volume is fine here because lead quality more than makes up for it. Don't apply this CTA pattern to self-serve/SMB flows.
generations.memory_57: Referral incentive (established accounts): referral starts +21%, qualified revenue +7%, retention +2%. Confirmed, but the effect is concentrated in accounts 6+ months old — newer accounts weren't tested/didn't show the same lift. Treat this as a lever for mature-account referral programs, not a general-purpose acquisition tool.
generations.memory_73: 40% targeted discount (price-sensitive SMB): big top-line numbers — signup +31%, qualified revenue +18% — but retention cratered -12%. The cohort we bought doesn't stick past the first renewal, so this reads as short-term sugar high rather than real growth. Important: do NOT treat this as evidence that discounting is a viable sustainable-growth lever. Any future discount tests should track cohort survival past renewal, not just initial conversion/revenue.
generations.memory_86: Shortened onboarding flow: completion +13%, time-to-value down 2.1 days, retention +3%. Clean confirmed win across the board with no tradeoffs noted — good candidate for broader rollout.
generations.memory_91: In-product activation messaging: week-one engagement +11%, activation +6%, retention +1%. Confirmed, modest but consistent positive across all metrics with no downside. Solid low-risk win.
